intent: Reuse the container outline and expose a single permitted path to the package directory. A banal storage service, rather than a concealed chat application, supplies the opportunity.
source:
**Frame:** The map rotates visually toward one permitted service: Artifactory, drawn as a plain package-cache directory tree. No glow.

**Action:** Package access remains available.

**Caption:**
> ONE SHARED SERVICE IS STILL VISIBLE.

**Provenance:** `documented` — Artifactory was reachable for package installation.
title: The permitted package service
